source: 2013/TSB Vol 13 No 18 Software Update for Smart Tech ATF.pdf
title: Software Update for Smart Tech ATF Machines
lead: MOC has released a new Firmware Revision (3.4) that we recommend to be installed in all Smart Tech™ Transmission Fluid Exchanging Machines as soon as possible.
body: This update has added a new screen to allow the technician to adjust the fluid level after the drain and fill process. Our results have shown a more accurate service with the new update.
